## [**Milestone 3**]{.underline}

<https://pudding.cool/2017/02/new-slang/>

-   Overview and context for how the data was collected and what the researcher is looking to find

    -   Lists all of the observations so we know variables of interest

-   Broke down the data into different categories of comparison (hip hop, politics, interest)

-   Gives a piece of data (graph/table) and explains what it means with a summary of the given data

    -   Uses different kinds of visualizations (picked ones that made the most sense for the context) → interactive!

    -   Uses same color scheme though to keep it consistent

    -   Ran comparisons by word category
